archetypes.name: contract-ledger
archetypes.rationale: Tracks whether the plan updates every published contract touched by folding validation, redaction, exit codes, and stale quick-skip behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the plan as a contract-change ledger across the scoped scripts, script docs, SKILL.md orchestration prose, and reference docs. Look for stale ownership claims, exit-code mismatches, precondition drift, or references to removed review_budget, skipped-quick, and --force-validate behavior that the plan does not explicitly cover. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: retry-state
archetypes.rationale: Focuses on the proposed Step 5c rc4 retry loop and whether all parsed state and cleanup decisions are coherently re-threaded.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the proposed defects-found path from design-publish.sh exit 4 through the shared validator prompt and Step 5c retry handling. Check whether the plan accounts for all state variables, result-env keys, final-summary gating, sentinel writes, footer handling, and cleanup preservation after Fix, Override, or Cancel. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-matrix
archetypes.rationale: Checks that the proposed tests prove the new folded publish contract rather than only deleting old prompt-side checks.
archetypes.prompt_body: Map each proposed behavior change to an offline harness assertion in the scoped test files. Pay special attention to validator infra failure versus defects-found, redaction failure versus empty output, skip-validate semantics, legacy run-params handling, and absence checks for removed knobs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
